description: Source code for the rlc_rx_um_entity class, implementing 3GPP RLC UM mode reception logic including PDU handling, SDU reassembly, and timer management.

classes.name: rlc_rx_um_entity
classes.description: Implements the reception entity for RLC UM mode, handling PDUs, SDU reassembly, and timers.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming PDU slices, handles SDU extraction, reassembly, and window management.

methods.name: on_expired_reassembly_timer
methods.description: Handles reassembly timer expiration, updating reassembly window and timers.

methods.name: handle_segment_data_sdu
methods.description: Processes SDU segments, stores them, and updates segment inventory.

methods.name: store_segment
methods.description: Stores a new SDU segment, merging or trimming overlapping segments.

methods.name: update_segment_inventory
methods.description: Updates flags indicating whether an SDU is fully received or has gaps.

methods.name: reassemble_sdu
methods.description: Reassembles a complete SDU from stored segments if fully received.

methods.name: sn_in_reassembly_window
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is within the reassembly window.

methods.name: sn_invalid_for_rx_buffer
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is invalid for the reception buffer based on window limits.
